name: Child Safety Refrigerator Lock | Baby Proof Double Button Fridge Lock White & Grey
description:
The Child Safety Refrigerator Lock keeps your fridge doors closed securely, ensuring safety for children, toddlers, and pets. Featuring a double-button system, it’s simple for adults to use but tough for little hands to open. With a sleek white and grey design, this lock blends seamlessly with most refrigerators while providing strong, reliable protection at home or the workplace.
Key Features
 Double-button system for child-proof security
 Auto-lock design for added convenience
 Strong 3M adhesive, no tools required
 Suitable for fridges, coolers, and mini-fridges
 Discreet design in white and grey
 Prevents kids, pets, or workplace access
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic, 3M adhesive
How to Use
 Clean and dry the fridge surface
 Peel off adhesive backing from lock
 Stick lock onto both doors, press firmly
 Press both buttons simultaneously to unlock
Package Includes
 1 × Child Safety Refrigerator Lock (White & Grey)
